style.summary: Finch builds cozy scenes: cartoon birds on sky-blue #9DDDFF skies and green grass, above white cards with 20 to 24 pt corners. Goals sit in 78 pt rows with an emoji tile, a bolt reward and a raised check button. Full-screen fills mark big moments: pink for a Valentine, bright blue #0E9BE2 for a 30-day streak.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: 16.5 pt side margins; a cartoon scene fills the top of the screen, and white cards stack below, 6.5 to 8 pt apart.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Cards round at 20 to 24 pt, icon tiles are 54 pt squircles, and check buttons round at 13 pt with a raised edge.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: Sky blue #9DDDFF backdrops, white #FFFFFF cards and bubbles, dark text #2E2E2E; bright blue #0E9BE2 fills the streak screen.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: Rubik sets every word: Bold 700 for 3-line headlines and 21 pt titles, Medium 500 for 17 pt rows and speech bubbles.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: Flat cartoon birds appear on all 8 shots, with props like hearts, trophies and dumbbells.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: Goal rows with a raised check button, 7-dot habit sparklines at a 14.7 pt pitch, and a streak week of check coins.

ourRead: 1 tier: 9 of 10 listings are Finch Plus, from $5.99 to $69.99. The 10th, Guardian Program at $7.99, is the only other name.
Prices lean high: 7 of 9 Finch Plus listings run $34.99 to $69.99. The top is 11.7x the lowest, $5.99, and all 10 end in .99.
Value comes first: a pet bird on all 8 screenshots, 6 of 8 headlines about doing it together, and Plus only in the In-App Purchases list.
stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Finch's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% sky blue #9DDDFF: skies and hero backdrops.
- 30% white #FFFFFF: cards, speech bubbles and sheets; text #2E2E2E.
- 10% bright blue #0E9BE2: streaks, selected checks and big moments.
- Rewards: orange bolts #FEAC31; done checks green #52B74E.
Type:
- Headlines: Rubik 700, 21 pt titles; 3-line heroes in dark blue #1F4F9A.
- Body: Rubik 500, 17 pt rows and bubbles; section labels in Rubik 600 caps, 12 pt, tracking 9%.
Shapes:
- Cards 20 to 24 pt corners; icon tiles 54 pt squircles.
- Check buttons: 13 pt corners, #F0F0F0 face, a 4 pt #D7D7D7 bottom edge.
Layout:
- 16.5 pt side margins; a cartoon scene on top, white cards below, 8 pt apart.
Components:
- Goal row: 78 pt white card, emoji tile, Rubik 600 name, bolt reward, check button.
- Habit sparkline: 7 columns, 14.7 pt pitch, bars and dots in the row's color.
- Speech bubble: white, fully rounded, tail toward the mascot.
Icons and imagery:
- A flat cartoon mascot in every hero; emoji-style icons in rows.
Check:
- Every card is white with 20 to 24 pt corners.
- The mascot appears on each main screen.
- Bright blue appears only on streaks and selections.
